name: SamSWAT.FOV v1.0.6 (SPT 4.0.13)
body:
## What is this?
Port of SamSWAT's FOV mod to SPT 4.0.13.

## Features
- FOV clamp customization (min/max)
- Horizontal/Vertical HUD camera offset
- F12 ConfigurationManager integration

## Changes for 4.0.13
- GClass1085 (was GClass1053)
- HarmonyLib (not Aki.Reflection)
- New NumberSlider API

## Credits
- SamSWAT — original mod
- DarkEsteves — SPT 4.0.13 port
